description: Commercial-intelligence extension for the Wave 4 prospect registry. Public-source contactability is never treated as marketing permission.

outreach_classes.CHANNEL_OK: A public channel explicitly intended for submissions, opportunities, supplier enquiries or equivalent use. Content still requires operator review.
outreach_classes.CONSENT_REQUEST_ONLY: A public organisational route exists, but only one governed consent request may be prepared before marketing content.
outreach_classes.RESEARCH_ONLY: Use for account research, prioritisation, introductions, events or inbound strategy. No electronic marketing release.
outreach_classes.BLOCKED: Do not contact. Withdrawal, refusal, do-not-contact or another hard block exists.

records.reason_now: Association access can convert one relationship into a multi-school pilot cohort.
records.pilot_hypothesis: A bounded HOMS evidence-readiness or assessment pilot introduced through SABISA can recruit 3-5 schools more efficiently than school-by-school cold outreach.

records.reason_now: A network-level demonstration or webinar can create qualified school pilots without mass principal outreach.
records.pilot_hypothesis: An association-supported HOMS demonstration can produce institutional pilot conversations with independent schools.

records.organisation: South African Monitoring and Evaluation Association (SAMEA)
records.reason_now: Tech-enabled MERL and evidence-governance use cases align directly with Evidex proof-led demonstrations.
records.pilot_hypothesis: A moderated SAMEA contribution or micro-session can recruit 3 Evidex pilots from organisations with live donor-reporting obligations.

records.buyer_role: school governing bodies and school governance leaders
records.reason_now: Governance and evidence-readiness pain can be tested through a multiplier organisation rather than individual schools.
records.pilot_hypothesis: A governance-oriented HOMS evidence-readiness demonstration can generate a small SGB/school pilot cohort.

records.buyer_role: school governing bodies and governance support
records.reason_now: Governance evidence, self-evaluation and document readiness create a concrete institutional wedge for HOMS.
records.pilot_hypothesis: A bounded governance-evidence pilot can demonstrate HOMS value before any network-wide offer.

records.organisation: Western Cape Education Department district network
records.reason_now: District and circuit structures provide multiplier access to schools, but require institutional rather than sales-style engagement.
records.pilot_hypothesis: A small, operator-led evidence-readiness demonstration could identify schools willing to test HOMS without implying departmental endorsement.

records.organisation: Department of Social Development NPO funding ecosystem
records.buyer_role: funded NPOs, funding applicants, compliance and programme teams
records.contact_point: official funding notices and public programme routes
records.source_reference: DSD NPO funding and compliance publications
records.reason_now: Funding and reporting cycles create recurring evidence-pack, provenance and compliance-readiness pain.
records.pilot_hypothesis: Use official funding categories to identify organisations with live evidence obligations, then approach through lawful association, inbound or consent-request routes.

records.organisation: National Association of School Governing Bodies
records.reason_now: Potential multiplier into governance-focused school cohorts.
records.pilot_hypothesis: A governance-evidence HOMS pilot can test whether SGB-facing value resonates before broader institutional outreach.

records.reason_now: Potential governance multiplier and referral source.
records.pilot_hypothesis: Test a bounded HOMS governance-evidence proof with a small referred cohort.

records.reason_now: Useful for constructing bounded school pilot cohorts after network and association routes are exhausted.
